description: Start on expanded catalog details with a known supported trailer already playing behind the hero, action focused. Preview-only: no feature playback, Watchlist or library mutations. Requires device video-plane and audio review.

steps.name: 01-catalog-background
steps.review: Trailer behind expanded hero/cast; configured background volume, default 50%.

steps.name: 02-catalog-promote
steps.review: Only shared trailer HUD remains; preview pipeline volume 100%.

steps.name: 03-catalog-pause
steps.review: Trailer pauses without opening feature playback.

steps.name: 04-catalog-resume
steps.review: Trailer resumes; seek/HUD remains the shared preview transport.

steps.name: 05-catalog-collapse
steps.review: Expanded details and cast return; configured background volume restored.

steps.name: 06-catalog-return-inline
steps.review: Inline card returns in the same shelf and trailer stops; no image overlay left behind.
